name: Onna Kyoushi Saeko ~Biniku Jugyou~
source:
New English teacher Saeko, 20 years old. She is enthusiastic to become a good educator, but faces merciless violence from men very soon. Saeko is stripped of pride and dignity... Is this the only future that awaits her now? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
二十岁的新英语教师香澄满怀热情，想成为优秀教育者，却很快遭遇男性无情的暴力。香澄的骄傲与尊严被剥夺……这就是等待她的唯一未来吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
